scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter ./apps/api run typecheck && pnpm --filter ./apps/web run typecheck && pnpm --filter ./packages/api-client run typecheck
scripts.lint: eslint --config packages/eslint-config/index.mjs --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern 'scripts/**/*.mjs' && pnpm --filter ./apps/api run lint && pnpm --filter ./apps/web run lint
scripts.format:check: prettier --check 'apps/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,mjs,json,css,yaml,yml,md}' 'packages/**/*.{ts,tsx,js,mjs,json,css,yaml,yml}' 'scripts/**/*.{js,mjs,cjs}' '.github/**/*.{yml,yaml}' package.json prettier.config.mjs pnpm-workspace.yaml README.md compose.yaml 'docs/**/*.md' specs/001-platform-foundation/quickstart.md
scripts.test: pnpm --filter ./apps/api run test && pnpm --filter ./apps/web run test
scripts.build: pnpm --filter ./apps/api run build && pnpm --filter ./apps/web run build
